selection.reason: Exploratory choice after inspecting both pilots: 0.025 barely restores Quiet Night envelope correlation; 0.05 improves log-band error and linear spectral convergence versus v1 while increasing correlation by over 0.05 on both pilots. Larger weights sacrifice more log-band fidelity.
